title: A Little Hand Goes Up
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The temple filled with golden light,
The throne was high and wide,
And angels sang a holy song
On every shining side.

[Chorus]
A little hand goes up tonight,
A small and steady hand:
"Here am I, and send me too,"
Wherever I may stand.

[Verse 2]
Isaiah felt so very small,
Too small for such a day;
An angel touched his lips with warmth
And worry blew away.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Then Heavenly Father asked aloud,
"Who'll go and share My word?"
Isaiah did not wait at all,
He spoke, and he was heard.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
So rest your brave and willing heart,
The lamp is burning low;
Tomorrow there'll be good to do,
And you'll be glad to go.

[Chorus]
mood: Answering music. A slow, open pulse with a small lift at the start of every line, like a hand going up before the person is quite sure what they have agreed to. A cello holds one low, warm note underneath while a nylon guitar picks a plain, steady figure across it, the two trading the tune line by line. It starts hushed and a little awed, then gathers certainty rather than volume, so the last verse sounds settled and ready.
